timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hi, my name is Daniel and I'm the co-founder and the CBO of Arcana Technology, building augmented reality metaverse.
Arcana Surface Recognition Algorithm connects the real and the digital worlds together into a single information space,
which is designed for everyday user-interactive experience with multimedia content in the real world around us.
Using just one single camera of any mobile device, we rebuild the digital 3D model of the world on the cloud.
With the future map, we recognize the environment, position the mobile device and the content in the real world with high accuracy.
With Arcana Surface of remote placement of the content outdoors in changing environment, the developer doesn't need to be present in the location to merge the digital content with the real landscape.
With Arcana Development Tools, any user without technical skills can create their own projects on fly.

Share it with the rest of the world by placing it remotely in the exact location in real geographical coordinates, allowing the users simultaneously to dive in into the mixed reality world around them.
We have launched the social network in augmented reality, where you can find the information on the digital billboards linked to the real world.
Travel in time and see how the city looked like in the past and navigate on the streets using augmented reality map.
We invite the people from the virtual space and social networks back to this real world, closer to the loved ones.
And give them the way to augment this reality with already habitual content.

youtube_description: The Arcona Metaverse creates a Digital Land - a layer of Augmented Reality uniting the physical and virtual worlds into a single information environment perfectly linked to our real world. It is designed for everyday user interactive experience with augmented, virtual and mixed reality multimedia content in real world locations.
